name: Iron Void : Silent Space
description:
About This Game

Alone in the void. One ship. One war.

Iron Void: Silent Space is a third-person space-combat game built around precise flight and reading the battlefield. Pilot a lone starfighter through the cold silence of deep space, weave between bullet-hell barrages, manage your weapon heat, lock on with missiles, and pick your moment to strike.

How it plays

  • Six-degree flight — throttle, steer, roll, boost, and a drift that freezes your momentum so you can spin and fire while sliding past danger.

  • Heat-managed primary cannon (no ammo, but overheat locks you out) plus limited lock-on homing missiles for the big targets.

  • Bullet-hell enemies that weave, strafe, swarm, and pin you down — read each archetype and break their pattern.

  • Four difficulty tiers, from a forgiving run to a brutal expert challenge.

A full campaign

  • 60 hand-built missions across distinct deep-space sectors — asteroid belts, ember nebulae, ghost-fleet graveyards, the dark frontier, and a corrupted void core.

  • Varied objectives — clear every hostile, survive a charging wave, destroy a defended station, or hold the line under a timer.

  • Five distinct boss battles, each a multi-phase fight with its own pattern to dismantle.

Progress and mastery

  • Earn money to unlock and buy distinct starfighters, each with its own handling, firepower, and feel.

  • Spend XP on hunter upgrades — steadier weapons, faster handling, richer salvage, and more.

  • Every mission is scored 1 to 3 stars. Replay to perfect your runs and fully clear the campaign.

  • 20 Steam Achievements to hunt down.

At a glance

  • Genre: third-person space combat / arcade bullet-hell

  • Single-player

  • Playable with a controller or mouse and keyboard

  • No co-op, no online — just you, your ship, and the silent void.

Just you, your ship, and the silent void.
short_desc: A lone fighter against the silent void. Weave through bullet-hell barrages across 60 hand-built missions, manage your heat, lock your missiles, and tear down 5 distinct bosses. Earn ships, upgrade your hunter, and master every star.
